response.overview: Unique Extrusion Machinery has been designing and fabricating PVC pipe manufacturing machines for over 10 years. We are based at Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad — right in the middle of Gujarat’s plastics machinery belt. Every machine we sell is built at our own facility. We do not outsource fabrication or resell parts made by someone else. We build the entire line ourselves. That includes the extruder, die head, vacuum calibration tank, haul-off unit, cutter, and socketing machine. One manufacturer. One line. No mismatched parts from three different vendors. We make both single-screw and twin-screw machines. Some buyers need a simple, reliable setup for HDPE or PPR pipe. Others need a heavy-duty twin-screw line for rigid PVC or CPVC at high output. We build for both, and we customise every machine to the pipe size, material, and output the buyer actually needs.
